escalation: 5% annual increase on each anniversary of the Commencement Date
cam: Tenant responsible for proportional share of operational, management, and maintenance expenses; payable within 15 days of invoice
renewal_option: One option to extend for 2 years; requires written notice 180 days prior to expiration
key_provisions: Rent payable in advance on or before first business day of each month
No deduction or set-off permitted for rent payments
Extension option lapses if not exercised timely
Tenant must not be in default to exercise renewal option
